# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. The release adds variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream helpers. All bundled native dependencies are refreshed with security updates. This is a breaking release — legacy SKPaint text APIs are now compile errors, typeface defaults changed, and Vulkan 1.1 is required. Review the breaking changes before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKPaint text/font APIs removed — use SKFont** — The legacy text-state properties on SKPaint (Typeface, TextSize, TextAlign, etc.) that were `[Obsolete]` since 2.x are now compile errors. Move typeface and text sizing onto SKFont and pass it alongside SKPaint. The remaining paint read-only state-inspection APIs (MeasureText via paint, etc.) are also gone. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null** — Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. After upgrading, `new SKFont().MeasureText("Hello")` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Pass an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect an unset typeface with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface is SKTypeface.Default, not null** — Paint now seeds a default font eagerly. Text still works, but code that checked `paint.Typeface == null` to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the null check.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android** — All platforms now return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family name. For strict null semantics use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) throws OverflowException and is obsolete** — The native offset is 32-bit; the long overload now uses a checked cast and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values, and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset instead.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan requires Vulkan 1.1 — process aborts on 1.0** — Skia Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion at 0 calls SK_ABORT — the process terminates, not an exception. Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on VkApplicationInfo and set MaxAPIVersion on GRVkBackendContext. Genuinely 1.0-only hardware must use raster or another GPU backend.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative — five fields removed** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice have been removed from the interop struct. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures, and delete the others.
- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value equality; GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped** — GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable<T> and the == / != operators are removed. GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update any equality comparisons to field-by-field checks.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed** — The protected setter for IgnorePublicDispose has been removed; the property is now get-only after construction. Subclasses that wrote to this property must set the value at construction time via the base-class constructor.

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded from m132 through m148 across four milestones** — The bundled Skia engine advances from milestone 132 to 148, bringing upstream bug fixes, new rendering capabilities, and the font-engine rework that underpins variable fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Upstream chrome/m147 and chrome/m148 stability syncs** — Three rounds of upstream bug-fix syncs from the chrome/m147 and chrome/m148 branches have been applied. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4054))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp** — Variable fonts with axis variation (weight, width, etc.) and color font palette selection are now supported. HarfBuzzSharp gains matching variation and palette APIs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — New SKWebpEncoder APIs let callers compose and encode animated WebP files from a sequence of SKBitmap or SKImage frames. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() for zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — A new GetData() helper returns the stream's underlying buffer as an SKData without copying, enabling zero-copy paths when reading from memory-backed streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **SKSamplingOptions support added to SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface** — Callers can now control the sampling filter (nearest, linear, cubic, etc.) when drawing one surface onto another. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **HBColor struct and missing API wrappers added** — A proper HBColor value type now wraps hb_color_t. Missing HarfBuzz API wrappers were added and naming-convention violations fixed. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrections** — GetPixelSpan incorrectly used Width instead of RowBytes for stride, causing wrong data in padded images, and used Height instead of Width for the x/y offset calculation. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first** — When the garbage collector finalized an SKPathBuilder before its derived SKPath, the path's finalizer would crash. The ownership relationship is now correctly modelled. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — Passing a region rect to SKImage.FromEncodedData leaked a native resource when the crop produced an empty image. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Default typeface resolution moved to the managed layer** — Android API 36+ no longer crashes when resolving SKTypeface.Default; the managed layer falls back gracefully instead of calling removed native APIs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9** — Consumers targeting .NET 9 with WinUI no longer encounter a missing projection DLL at runtime. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — The mechanism that keeps singleton SKObject instances (surfaces, contexts, etc.) alive across GC cycles has been redesigned to be more deterministic and less prone to use-after-free scenarios. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved from ModuleInitializer to SkiaApi constructor** — The check that validates native library compatibility now runs in the SkiaApi static constructor, making it easier to diagnose and handle initialization failures. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs aligned to SDK conventions** — Library TFMs now use the versioned 26.0 form while app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing deployment issues on newer Xcode. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **Linux Bionic native assets** — Native binaries for Linux Bionic (Android-derived Linux environment) are now included in the NuGet packages. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native build support** — The Tizen platform now ships native binaries for both x64 and arm64 architectures. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WASM pre-.NET 8 Emscripten builds dropped** — Native WASM libraries built against pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are no longer shipped, simplifying the package and reducing size. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Six bundled native dependencies updated** — libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5 / 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, freetype 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, and HarfBuzz 14.2.0 are now bundled, picking up security and bug fixes from each upstream. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding full variable font axis support, color font palette APIs, a new HBColor value type, and the HarfBuzz 14.2.0 engine update.
